```{r Library}
library(tidyverse)
library(Biostrings)
```

```{r import data}
gtdbtk <- read_tsv("gtdbtk/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv")
gtdbtk
metabat_66 <- read_tsv("prokka/metabat.66/metabat.66.tsv")
metabat_66

flye_assembly <- readDNAStringSet("flye/bbd/assembly.fasta")
flye_assembly

checkm_lines <- readLines("checkm/checkm_results_bbd.txt")
checkm_lines
```

### Tidying the gtdbtk df

```{r first try at tidy}
gtdbtk |>
  separate_longer_delim(classification, delim = ";") |> 
  group_by(user_genome) |>
  slice_tail(n=3) |> 
  summarise(short_classification=paste(classification, collapse = " "))
```


```{r}
# shorter code for the same 
gtdbtk_taxonomy2 <- gtdbtk |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    classification, delim = ";",
    names = c("domain", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "genus", "species")
  ) |>
  mutate(across(domain:species, ~ na_if(str_remove(.x, "^[a-z]__"), ""))) |>
  select(user_genome, domain:species)

gtdbtk_taxonomy2
```


### CheckM results (lines 104–125) 
```{r}
# Keep actual bin-result lines only
checkm_lines <- checkm_lines[
  grepl("^(contig_|metabat\\.)", trimws(checkm_lines))
]

# Split whitespace-delimited CheckM output
checkm_split <- strsplit(trimws(checkm_lines), "\\s+")

checkm_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(checkm_split, function(x) {
  data.frame(
    bin = x[1],
    lineage = x[2],
    completeness = as.numeric(x[13]),
    contamination = as.numeric(x[14])
  )
}))

checkm_df
```


### Join

```{r}
bin_table <- checkm_df |>
  left_join(gtdbtk_taxonomy2, by = c("bin" = "user_genome")) |>
  mutate(label = coalesce(species, genus, family, order, class, phylum, domain))
bin_table
```




### Figures 

**GTDB-Tk taxonomy table**
```{r}
checkm_top <- bin_table |>
  filter(completeness > 15) |>
  mutate(y_label = paste0(label, " (", bin, ")")) |>
  arrange(completeness)

ggplot(
  checkm_top,
  aes(
    x = completeness,
    y = reorder(y_label, completeness)
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(completeness, 1), "%")),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 120),
  breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
) +
  labs(
    x = "Genome completeness (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 30, 5.5, 5.5)
  )
```

### Assembly quality

```{r}
n50 <- function(x) { x <- sort(x, decreasing = TRUE); x[cumsum(x) >= sum(x) / 2][1] }
len <- width(flye_assembly)

assembly_stats <- tibble(
  contigs   = length(len),
  total_Mb  = sum(len) / 1e6,
  longest_Mb = max(len) / 1e6,
  N50_kb    = n50(len) / 1e3
)
assembly_stats
```
- assembly is fragmented overall but with at least one very contiguous genome

Bin quality from CheckM, using the MIMAG thresholds:

```{r}
bin_table |>
  summarise(
    bins_total   = n(),
    over_15      = sum(completeness > 15),
    medium_qual  = sum(completeness >= 50 & contamination < 10),
    high_qual    = sum(completeness > 90 & contamination < 5)
  )
```
### Prokka genes and EC numbers
```{r}
bins <- readLines("checkm/bbd_topbins.txt")

prokka_all <- map_dfr(bins, \(b)
  read_tsv(file.path("prokka", b, paste0(b, ".tsv")), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(bin = b))

prokka_all |> summarise(features = n(),
                        CDS = sum(ftype == "CDS"),
                        with_EC = sum(!is.na(EC_number)))

prokka_all |> group_by(bin) |>
  summarise(CDS = sum(ftype == "CDS"), with_EC = sum(!is.na(EC_number)))
```

Minpath (Q4.1 and Q4.2)
```{r}
rx <- "^path\\s+(\\S+)\\s+.*naive\\s+(\\d+)\\s+minpath\\s+(\\d+)\\s+fam0\\s+(\\d+)\\s+fam-found\\s+(\\d+)\\s+name\\s+(.*)$"

minpath_all <- map_dfr(
  list.files("minpath", pattern = "\\.ec\\.report$", full.names = TRUE),
  \(f) {
    m <- str_match(read_lines(f), rx)
    m <- m[!is.na(m[, 1]), , drop = FALSE]
    tibble(bin = str_remove(basename(f), "\\.ec\\.report$"),
           pathway = m[, 2], naive = as.integer(m[, 3]),
           minpath = as.integer(m[, 4]), fam0 = as.integer(m[, 5]),
           fam_found = as.integer(m[, 6]), name = m[, 7])
  })

key_paths <- minpath_all |>
  filter(pathway %in% c("PWY-101", "PWY-5360")) |>
  left_join(gtdbtk_taxonomy, by = c("bin" = "user_genome")) |>
  mutate(complete = fam_found == fam0) |>
  select(pathway, bin, fam0, fam_found, complete, minpath, phylum, class, order, family, genus)

key_paths |> arrange(pathway, desc(fam_found))
```
